# Save and restore a notebook

Consider a notebook with two sections that refer to the same note. The archive
must preserve the note's fields, the section structure, and the fact that both
sections point to one object. Each class writes fields with `encodeWithCoder()`
and restores them with `initWithCoder()`. The coder accepts both plain R values
and RObjC objects; it traverses ordinary lists containing RObjC objects.

These classes are defined in this script, so they must be mapped to current
generators before decoding. An extension package can instead register its
classes in `.onLoad()`; see
`vignette("robjc_encoding_strategy", package = "robjc")`.

```{r}
library(robjc)

Note <- RSObjectClass(
  "EncodingGuideNote", version = "1.0",
  public = list(
    title = NULL,
    priority = NULL,
    initialize = function(title, priority) {
      super$initialize()
      self$title <- title
      self$priority <- priority
      invisible(self)
    },
    encodeWithCoder = function(coder) {
      coder$encodeObjectForKey(self$title, "title")
      coder$encodeObjectForKey(self$priority, "priority")
    },
    initWithCoder = function(coder) {
      self$title <- coder$decodeObjectForKey("title")
      self$priority <- coder$decodeObjectForKey("priority")
      invisible(self)
    }
  )
)

Section <- RSObjectClass(
  "EncodingGuideSection", version = "1.0",
  public = list(
    name = NULL,
    notes = NULL,
    initialize = function(name, notes = list()) {
      super$initialize()
      self$name <- name
      self$notes <- notes
      invisible(self)
    },
    encodeWithCoder = function(coder) {
      coder$encodeObjectForKey(self$name, "name")
      coder$encodeObjectForKey(self$notes, "notes")
    },
    initWithCoder = function(coder) {
      self$name <- coder$decodeObjectForKey("name")
      self$notes <- coder$decodeObjectForKey("notes")
      invisible(self)
    }
  )
)

Notebook <- RSObjectClass(
  "EncodingGuideNotebook", version = "1.0",
  public = list(
    sections = NULL,
    initialize = function(sections = list()) {
      super$initialize()
      self$sections <- sections
      invisible(self)
    },
    encodeWithCoder = function(coder) {
      coder$encodeObjectForKey(self$sections, "sections")
    },
    initWithCoder = function(coder) {
      self$sections <- coder$decodeObjectForKey("sections")
      invisible(self)
    }
  )
)
```

## Archive the graph

The same `shared_note` appears in both sections. The archiver records five
instances: one notebook, two sections, and two distinct notes. A second
reference to `shared_note` points to its existing archive record.

```{r}
shared_note <- Note$new("Release checklist", 2.5)
draft_note <- Note$new("Draft outline", 1)
notebook <- Notebook$new(list(
  Section$new("Current", list(shared_note, draft_note)),
  Section$new("Archive", list(shared_note))
))

archive <- RSKeyedArchiver$new()$archive(notebook)
stopifnot(length(archive$records) == 5L)

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
saveRDS(archive, path)
saved <- readRDS(path)
unlink(path)
```

## Inspect and map classes

`RSKeyedUnarchiver$new()` reads the archive without constructing any notebook
objects. `showAllClasses()` returns a tibble containing the saved class names,
versions, resolution status, and a `decoder_class` list column. These
script-defined classes are unresolved, so map each to its current generator.

```{r}
available <- list(
  EncodingGuideNote = Note,
  EncodingGuideSection = Section,
  EncodingGuideNotebook = Notebook
)
decoder <- RSKeyedUnarchiver$new(saved)
classes <- decoder$showAllClasses()
stopifnot(nrow(classes) == 3L)
stopifnot(all(classes$status == "unresolved"))
classes$decoder_class <- unname(available[classes$class_name])
decoder$setClasses(classes)
loaded <- decoder$decode()
```

The same mapping can be edited through `dictionaryWithAllClasses()` and passed
to `setClasses()`. Package-registered classes resolve automatically and are
hidden by the default `showAllClasses(remove_default = TRUE)` view.

## Verify restored state and identity

```{r}
stopifnot(identical(loaded$class(), Notebook))
stopifnot(identical(loaded$sections[[1L]]$name, "Current"))
stopifnot(identical(loaded$sections[[1L]]$notes[[2L]]$title, "Draft outline"))
stopifnot(identical(loaded$sections[[1L]]$notes[[1L]]$priority, 2.5))
stopifnot(identical(
  loaded$sections[[1L]]$notes[[1L]],
  loaded$sections[[2L]]$notes[[1L]]
))
```

The last check verifies object identity, not merely matching note text.
Decoding allocates current instances without running their `initialize()`
methods, then restores the fields written by each class. When a field layout
changes, `initWithCoder()` can inspect `coder$savedClassVersion()` to handle
older archives. The keyed archive format is currently `robjc-keyed-1`.
